* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Card image published 1 June 2022, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/tarfful.gif</code> as published 1 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/tarfful.gif holotable commit e8445f0] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “If a battle was just initiated at same site, may name an Interrupt; for remainder of battle, Interrupts with that title may not be played unless they are [Immune to Sense]. '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the image only: the PC re-rendered the Virtual Set 16 card images (the side credit and copyright lines and the typesetting of the game text changed; on some cards icons or the set-icon position also changed); the game text words are the same. A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
